description: Lists the open times for a free 15-minute fit call with Joe Hill, by video. Without a date, the coming open times grouped by day; with one, every open time on that day. The result names its time zone and includes today, today's date in Central time, for working out a day like "Friday". Each time has a start value to pass to book_call.

date.description: Optional. One day as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from the today value in an earlier result. Returns every open time on that day.

name: get_availability
title: See Joe's open call times
